messages:
marco: Heads-up — noticed a huge spike in noisy alerts when tenant sampling rolled last night. Console shows ~90% of alert volume from 3 tenants. Can we add an ambient sampling fallback + a quiet-window UI to reduce pager noise? cc @sophie @yang :thinking_face:

sophie: Do you mean a per-tenant quiet window that suppresses duplicate fanout for a window (eg 5m)? Curious how this would tie into per-route SLO surfaces and SLAs.

yang: I think two pieces: (1) a rules engine to detect storms and switch policy, (2) a console surface to preview and control it. We also need telemetry hooks (unique_tenants, suppressed_count, sample_rate).

marco: Exactly. My rough proposal: console lets you configure a fallback policy with modes: `suppress` (drop duplicates, only one notify) or `aggregate` (send an aggregated low-sev alert + counts). Default to `aggregate` for safety.

lina: FYI ops-bot saw 1.2k alerts in 10m at 03:20 UTC — oncall was saturated. We need something fast.

yang: API contract idea: new endpoint to attach fallback to an SLO/NotifyPolicy. Example payload: 
```json
POST /api/v1/notify-policies/:id/fallbacks
{
  "mode": "aggregate",
  "trigger": {"type": "rate", "threshold": 100, "window_sec": 300},
  "sample_rate": 0.1,
  "quiet_window_sec": 300
}
```
This would let the runtime flip routing behavior when triggers fire.

sophie: UX asks: can we preview estimated impact before toggling? show estimated suppressed alerts, tenants affected, and simulated latency to oncall? If we have a dry-run preview it helps trust.

marco: Agreed. Preview should use last-7d signal to estimate suppression and cost delta. Also add a per-tenant opt-out for customers.

devex: For SDKs we can include a hint field so integrators can annotate events: `notify_hint: {fallback: "aggregate", dedupe_key: "tenant+route"}` — this helps runtime dedupe without changing existing events. We'll include small changelog and migration notes.

ops-bot: IncidentBot: created incident INC-4522 for alert storm detected at 1765554300, linked alerts: 1204, paging: 6 teams.

yang: Rollout plan: (A) API + dry-run backend (B) console preview + telemetry dashboards (C) enable aggregation in canary tenants (D) enable suppress mode once confidence > 95%. Also add audit logs and an allowlist for enterprise tenants.

marco: Quick proposed thresholds for initial canary: if >100 alerts in 5m from a single tenant AND >50% are duplicates, flip to `aggregate` with `sample_rate=0.2` and `quiet_window_sec=300`. All values editable in console per-policy.

sophie: Small nit: make aggregated alert include top-5 example traces and affected route IDs so SREs can triage without flipping off suppression.

marco: Will sketch API PR + console mock today. TODOs: [1] API schema PR (yang), [2] UI mock (sophie), [3] telemetry dashboard (devex), [4] canary rollout checklist (lina).

lina: I'll open a short runbook for oncall behavior when aggregation is active.

marco: Thanks — leaving this as the tracking thread. Will follow up with PR links and screenshots. :thumbsup:
